newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP says sold 8.6 million BNP shares. [CORRECTED 19:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BNP says sold 8.6 million BNP shares. [CORRECTED 19:24 GMT]

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris said on Friday it had sold 8.641 million of its own shares that it had acquired through a buyout of minority shareholders in investment subsidiary CIP during a share swap last year (corrects to show shares sold were treasury stock in BNP, not in CIP).
BNP held 8,641,000 shares as treasury stock after buying out minority CIP shareholders in a one-for-one share swap last June.
BNP said in a statement it had sold all these shares during the second half of 1996 and January 1997 for undisclosed sums.
A BNP spokeswoman declined to give a value for the sale or detail whether it showed a capital gain or loss.
BNP had 84 percent of CIP before the June share swap and now controls just over 98 percent, the spokeswoman said.
